notes: All numeric font gates are measured font / page height * 540, not raw arbitrary defaults.
A sparse page alone never proves section, cover, or reasonable whitespace intent.
Numeric section needs marker position, measured typography, short companion title, sparse structure, and absence of substantial chart/table/image evidence.
Unknown or ambiguous intent remains unknown; absence of a role candidate is not confirmation of normality.
Local annotations require an explicit note/source prefix and a nearby chart/table/image; small font alone never establishes auxiliary status.
This adapter never reads modification types, generator labels, human labels, old predictions, or template identifiers.
